title: Yara and the Static
author: Ines Joubert
blurb: Bram Almeida, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
